verdict.rationale: Docs show bbox_annotation for charts/figures, include_blocks with paragraph-level bounding boxes and structural labels in reading order, and document_annotation for full-document summaries — directly supporting figure/chart extraction with page-traceable positions. Community confirms real-world extraction of embedded images, but one hands-on report shows a failure mode where an entire page was misclassified as a single image rather than granular figure regions, indicating inconsistent reliability. Missing for 10: explicit example of VLM-generated descriptive summaries (vs. just bbox coordinates), independent benchmarking of figure/chart bounding-box accuracy across document types.
